source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The owned patch adds ews to the POP advanced control hidefor list. Account Settings passes the selected type to its local hideShowControls helper, which changes hidden from exact comma-separated membership. A separate EWS advanced control remains. The child hidden-data hbox change is redundant with the containing POP vbox and was described as consistency cleanup. This is a visibility contract, not removal of a backend capability or a rendered-dialog result.
title: Exchange server settings hide the POP advanced control through server-type metadata
